questions.question: Define electronic excitation and explain its significance in photochemistry.
questions.solution_html:
• Definition: Electronic excitation is the process in which an electron absorbs energy and moves
  • from a lower-energy electronic state to a higher-energy electronic state. This occurs when the
  • absorbed energy matches the energy difference between the two electronic states.(Any proper
  • definition give (2 marks)).
  • Explanation: This process initiates photochemical reactions by generating highly reactive species
  • altering molecular geometry, and enabling pathways like fluorescence, phosphorescence, or
  • energy transfer. (Any three relevant points give (3 marks))
questions.final_answer: energy transfer. (Any three relevant points give )
